editor_notes: Read all160terrain/map constraints and experiment descriptions.
Visible mapnames consistently used in errors: मूँगा, कठिन मार्ग, झीलों के बीच ज़मीनी रास्ते; English operational identifiers unchanged.

All resourcegrowth/projectile/swimming/walking restrictions preserved exactly; generated-map failure alternatives and sizebounds retained.
